work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The mass book of the use of Salisbury, the dominant English use before 1549. Its Temporale numbers the Sundays after Trinity rather than after Pentecost, and its formularies do not stand in one-to-one correspondence with the Roman ones. A locus is the formulary heading with the printed column.
work.title: Missale ad usum insignis et praeclarae ecclesiae Sarum
